instruction.text: Verbinde jeden Satzanfang mit dem passenden Satzende.

atoms.a: He has his own money box
atoms.b: because he wants to save money.
atoms.sound: He has his own money box because he wants to save money.

atoms.b: by putting some of his pocket money aside.
atoms.sound: He saves some money by putting some of his pocket money aside.

atoms.a: He wants to buy brand name products
atoms.b: since all of his friends do that too.
atoms.sound: He wants to buy brand name products since all of his friends do that too.

atoms.a: Ich mache das nicht. Ich habe es versucht, aber es ist wirklich schwer, nicht alles auf einmal auszugeben.
atoms.b: I don't. I tried, but it's really hard to not ((++spend save)) it all at once.

atoms.a: Auch für mich ist es nicht einfach. Allerdings möchte ich Markenprodukte kaufen und diese sind sehr teuer.
atoms.b: It is not easy for me either. However, I want to buy ((++brand_name_products home_made_products)) and they are very ((++expensive cheap)).

atoms.a: Ich interessiere mich nicht für Markenprodukte. Deshalb habe ich nicht das Bedürfnis, Geld zu sparen.
atoms.b: I don't care about brand name products. That's why I don't feel the ((++need want)) to save some money.

atoms.a: Das ist in Ordnung. Ich denke jedoch, dass es immer nützlich ist, etwas Geld zu sparen, falls man es braucht.
atoms.b: That's okay. However, I think it is always ((++useful useless)) to save some money in case you need it.

atoms.a: Das ist richtig. Wie viel Geld sparst du?
atoms.b: That's true. How much ((++money clothes)) do you save?

atoms.a: Ich versuche, 10 Pfund pro Monat zu sparen. Manchmal sogar noch mehr. Und den Rest meines Taschengeldes gebe ich für verschiedene Dinge aus.
atoms.b: I try to save ((++£10 10€)) per month. Sometimes even more. And the rest of my pocket money I spend on different things.
atoms.sound: I try to save 10 pounds per month. Sometimes even more. And the rest of my pocket money I spend on different things.
